paper.title: Self-Consolidation for Self-Evolving Agents
paper.central_claim: EvoSC以成功/失败对比提取文本经验，并将历史轨迹蒸馏到20个可学习提示，实现可扩展、上下文高效的长期代理进化，优于经验回放。

provenance.notes: 按派发sonnet席位和环境所述gpt-6.1-sol执行；无可核验运行收据或会话标识，actual_model保留null，不另探测。

materials.notes: HTML图只有题注；manifest无page_images。图内具体模板/曲线不推测；主要方法公式与数表在文本。

evidence.quote: First, by focusing solely on success, agents overlook the rich pedagogical value embedded in failed attempts, preventing them from identifying and avoiding recurrent pitfalls.
evidence.support_explanation: 具体问题为忽略失败与文本记忆扩张。

evidence.quote: To maintain memory efficiency and relevance, these extracted insights are stored in a first-in-first-out (FIFO) queue, ensuring the agent prioritizes recent lessons while automatically pruning outdated error information. These insights then guide the agent in tackling subsequent tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 持久化文本队列在后续任务读取，FIFO不等于效用门控。

evidence.quote: Instead of solely replaying successful demonstrations, the agent retrieves and analyzes both successful and failed historical trajectories.
This action is generated by the LLM when it is provided with the many historical trajectory set
evidence.support_explanation: 教师读大量历史产生动作；公式5、6、损失定义软提示蒸馏。

evidence.quote: Database (DB, 500 tasks), Operating System (OS, 500 tasks), and Knowledge Graph (KG, 396 tasks).

To mitigate experimental randomness, we run each experiment three times with random seeds and report the averaged results. All experiments are conducted on Linux servers, with each experiment utilizing two NVIDIA A40 (48G) GPUs.
evidence.support_explanation: 有三种子与硬件，未给误差线/搜索方差及总成本。

evidence.quote: “EE” and “SE” denote the error-prone experience and successful experience, respectively, while “PTC” denotes the parametric trajectory consolidation.
evidence.support_explanation: 消融区分两类文本经验与参数固化。

evidence.quote: The evaluation metric is the task success rate, which is defined as the proportion of correct action sequences that complete the task successfully.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行任务成功率是对应指标。

evidence.quote: the relatively simplistic experience retrieval mechanism inevitably constrains the reasoning capabilities of agents.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认检索与小模型限制。

evidence.quote: thereby improving the success rate on future tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 目标是利用先前经验提升之后任务而非仅重试。
正文称相关检索，Algorithm1则最近成功轨迹，接口存在歧义。
